_doc: hero-1v1-cont1h u11650 continued on Curio (docs/curio-hero-2026-10-31.md). Same recipe as experiments/hero/hero-1v1-cont1h.json: the parent's omniscient critic is loaded (critic_path, set by curio.py to the staged latest-critic.npz) so there is no fresh-critic reset; LR starts below the parent's 3e-4 because the rules moved (PR #11) and the parent already saw 6.95 B samples. training_seconds and critic_path are filled in at launch. stream_views is OFF on Curio: DeviceRows page streaming deadlocked the 4-GPU allreduce on this host (trial a-stream-off vs control, 2026-10-31). coded_views on: actors send sparse row deltas, the learner decodes on the GPUs (66k vs 35k samples/s, trial t2).
